title: Marathi Kitchen Items: Cooking, Utensils & Appliances
description: 40 Marathi kitchen words - rooms, utensils, appliances, cooking verbs - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and examples from Unit 03 and Food category.
intro: Forty Marathi kitchen words covering rooms (स्वयंपाकघर, भोजनकक्ष), utensils (कढाई, तवा, चमचा), appliances (मिक्सर, फ्रिज, स्टोव), and cooking verbs (उकळणे, तळणे, भाजणे). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Unit 03 introduces the kitchen as a room (स्वयंपाकघर) and the Food category adds ingredients and cooking verbs. Together they form a complete kitchen vocabulary for daily use and recipes.
tip: Pair nouns with cooking verbs: कढाई + तळणे (fry in a wok), तवा + भाजणे (roast on a griddle), पतीला + उकळणे (boil in a pot).

sections.heading: Rooms & big appliances
paragraphs: स्वयंपाकघर (kitchen), भोजनकक्ष (dining room), फ्रिज (fridge), मिक्सर (mixer), स्टोव (stove), ओव्हन (oven). These are the nouns you will see on rental listings and appliance manuals.

mistakes.why: किचन is an English loan; स्वयंपाकघर is the standard Marathi word used in daily speech and real estate.

mcq.question: Kitchen in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: स्वयंपाकघर (svayampākghar) — self-cooking-house, the standard Marathi word.

translate.source: Fry the onions in a wok.
translate.note: कढाईत = in the wok (locative); तळा = fry (imperative).

faq.question: How many kitchen words are on this page?
faq.answer: 40 -- rooms, appliances, utensils and cooking verbs, each with Hindi meaning and example sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for "kitchen"?
faq.answer: स्वयंपाकघर (svayampākghar) -- literally "self-cooking-house".

title: Marathi Health Symptoms: Pain, Fever, Cough & More
description: 16 Marathi symptom and health words - दुखणं, ताप, खोकला, सर्दी, उलटी - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and doctor-visit examples from Units 10 and 17.
intro: Sixteen Marathi symptom words from the Body and Medical categories: दुखणं (pain), ताप (fever), खोकला (cough), सर्दी (cold), उलटी (vomiting), दस्त (diarrhea), एलर्जी (allergy), सुज (swelling). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a doctor-visit example sentence.

Unit 10 teaches the dative pattern for symptoms: मला ताप आहे (I have fever), मला खोकला आहे (I have a cough). Unit 17 extends this to body-states. This page collects the symptom vocabulary you need at a clinic or pharmacy.
tip: Use मला + symptom + आहे for all symptoms: मला ताप आहे, मला खोकला आहे, मला दस्त आहे. The pattern is identical to Hindi मुझे ... है.

sections.heading: The मला … आहे pattern
paragraphs: Symptoms arrive TO you in Marathi: मला ताप आहे (fever is to me), मला खोकला आहे (cough is to me), मला दस्त आहे (diarrhea is to me). The noun (ताप, खोकला, दस्त) is the subject; मला marks the experiencer. Hindi speakers: this mirrors मुझे ... है exactly.

sections.heading: Pain locations — body part + दुखते
paragraphs: Combine body part + दुखते: माझं डोके दुखते (headache), माझे पोट दुखते (stomach ache), माझं पाठ दुखते (back pain), माझे हात दुखते (arm pain). The body part is the subject and agrees with दुखते.

mistakes.wrong: Saying मुझे ताप है for fever
mistakes.why: Symptoms take the dative मला pattern: मला ताप आहे, मला खोकला आहे — Unit 10 curriculum.
Marathi uses the verb दुखते with body part as subject: डोके दुखते. दर्द is a Hindi noun.
बुखार is Hindi; ताप is the Marathi word used in medical and daily contexts.

mcq.question: How do you say "I have a fever" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला ताप आहे — dative मला + symptom + आहे.

mcq.question: Cough in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: खोकला (khoklā) = cough. सर्दी = cold (illness).

mcq.question: "My stomach hurts" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: माझे पोट दुखते — body part as subject, neuter possessive माझे.

faq.question: How many symptom words are on this page?
faq.answer: 16 — pain, fever, cough, cold, vomiting, diarrhea, allergy, swelling and more, each with Hindi meaning and doctor-visit sentence.

faq.question: How do you say "I have a cough" in Marathi?
faq.answer: मला खोकला आहे — the standard Unit 10 pattern for symptoms.

title: Marathi City Places: Stations, Markets, Hospitals & More
description: 25 Marathi city place words - station, market, hospital, bank, temple, bridge - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and travel examples from Units 14 and 15.
intro: Twenty-five Marathi city place words from the Travel category: station (स्टेशन), market (बाजार), hospital (दवाखाना), bank (बँक), temple (मंदिर), bridge (पूल), highway (महामार्ग), airport (विमानतळ). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real travel example sentence.
Units 14 and 15 sentences like मुंबईला जाणारा ट्रेन कोणता? and ऑटो घेऊन स्टेशनला गेले put these words in the exact exchanges you will have navigating a Maharashtrian city.
tip: Learn in functional groups: transport hubs (स्टेशन, प्लॅटफॉर्म, बस स्टॉप), services (दवाखाना, बँक, पोस्ट ऑफिस), landmarks (मंदिर, मस्जिद, गुरुद्वारा, चर्च).

sections.heading: Transport hubs
paragraphs: स्टेशन (station), प्लॅटफॉर्म (platform), तिकीट (ticket), तिकीटघर (ticket office), बस स्टॉप (bus stop), विमानतळ (airport), बंदर (port/harbor). These get you from A to B.

sections.heading: Services & landmarks
paragraphs: दवाखाना (clinic/hospital), बँक (bank), मंदिर (temple), मस्जिद (mosque), गुरुद्वारा (gurudwara), चर्च (church), पोस्ट ऑफिस (post office), पुलिस स्टेशन (police station). The words you need when something goes wrong or you need a service.

mistakes.why: अस्पताल is Hindi/Urdu; दवाखाना (drug-house) is the standard Marathi word on signs and in speech.
पुल is Hindi; पूल is the Marathi spelling convention for the English loan.

mistakes.right: बाजार = traditional market; मार्केट = modern market/mall
mistakes.why: Both exist; बाजार is the everyday word for a street market, मार्केट for organized markets.

mcq.question: Bridge in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: पूल (pūl) — Marathi spelling of the English loan.

mcq.question: Airport in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: विमानतळ (vimāntaḷ) — विमान (plane) + तल (ground).

faq.question: How many city place words are on this page?
faq.answer: 25 — transport hubs, services, landmarks and civic places, each with Hindi meaning and travel sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for "hospital"?
faq.answer: दवाखाना (davākhānā) — not अस्पताल (that's Hindi).

title: Marathi Personality Adjectives: Traits, Moods & Character
description: Selected Marathi personality adjectives — स्वभाव, मन, बुद्धी, धीर, उत्साही — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and gender agreement from the Adjectives category.
intro: A curated selection of Marathi personality adjectives from the Adjectives (68) and Abstract (36) categories: स्वभाव (nature/temperament), मन (mind/heart), बुद्धी (intelligence), धीर (patient), उत्साही (enthusiastic), संवेदनशील (sensitive), दृढ (determined), लाजाळू (shy). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation, gender agreement notes and example sentences.
Personality words follow the same gender agreement as all adjectives: masculine ends in -ा, feminine in -ी, neuter in -े. Learn the citation form (masculine) and the pattern gives you all three.
tip: Learn in opposite pairs: धीर/उतावळा (patient/impatient), उत्साही/उदासीन (enthusiastic/apathetic), संवेदनशील/कठोर (sensitive/hard-hearted).

sections.heading: Core personality traits
paragraphs: Positive: धीर (patient), उत्साही (enthusiastic), दृढ (determined), संवेदनशील (sensitive), बुद्धिमान (intelligent), सरळ (simple/honest), उदार (generous). Negative: उतावळा (impatient), उदासीन (apathetic), कठोर (hard/stern), स्वार्थी (selfish), अहंकारी (arrogant). Each agrees with the person described.

sections.heading: Gender agreement in action
paragraphs: तो धीर आहे (he is patient), ती धीर आहे (she is patient), ते धीर आहे (it/child is patient). The adjective ending changes: धीर (masc), धीर (fem - same), धीर (neut - same). For adjectives ending in -ा: उत्साही (masc), उत्साही (fem), उत्साही (neut). The pattern is consistent.

mistakes.right: स्वभाव = nature/temperament (noun); use धीर, उत्साही for adjectives
mistakes.why: स्वभाव is the noun "temperament"; to describe someone, use the adjectives that derive from it.

mistakes.wrong: Assuming all personality words end in -ा
mistakes.right: Many end in -ी (उत्साही, संवेदनशील) or are invariant (धीर, बुद्धिमान)
mistakes.why: Adjectives follow different declension classes. Learn each word's citation form and its agreement pattern.

mcq.question: Patient in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: धीर (dhīr) = patient; opposite is उतावळा (impatient).

mcq.question: Shy in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: लाजाळू (lājāḷū) = shy/bashful.

mcq.question: Intelligent in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: बुद्धिमान (buddhīmān) = intelligent; बुद्धी = intelligence (noun).

faq.question: How many personality words are on this page?
faq.answer: A curated selection of ~25 personality adjectives from the Adjectives and Abstract categories, with gender agreement and examples.

faq.question: How do personality adjectives agree with gender?
faq.answer: Same as all adjectives: masculine -ा, feminine -ी, neuter -े. Many personality words (धीर, उत्साही, संवेदनशील) are invariant or follow the -ी declension.

title: Marathi Direction Words: Left, Right, Here, There & Beyond
description: 16 Marathi direction and location words - डावा, उजवा, सरळ, इथे, तिथे, आत, बाहेर - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and navigation examples from Units 08 and 14.
h1: Marathi Direction & Location Words (दिशा आणि ठिकाण)
intro: Sixteen Marathi direction and location words from the Directions category: डावा (left), उजवा (right), सरळ (straight), इथे (here), तिथे (there), आत (inside), बाहेर (outside), समोर (in front), मागे (behind), बाजूला (beside), पलीकडे (across), मार्ग (route). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a navigation example.
Unit 08 speaking sentences like सरळ जा, डावीकडे वळा and Unit 14 landscape vocabulary put these words in real navigation contexts.
tip: डावा = left, उजवा = right, सरळ = straight, थांबा = stop. Say them while walking — muscle memory beats flashcards.

sections.heading: The core four
paragraphs: डावा (left), उजवा (right), सरळ (straight), थांबा (stop) — every direction sentence in Units 08 and 14 builds from these four. Add इथे (here) and तिथे (there) for location.

sections.heading: Relative positions
paragraphs: आत (inside), बाहेर (outside), समोर (in front), मागे (behind), बाजूला (beside), पलीकडे (across), मध्ये (between). These answer "where exactly?" relative to a landmark.

mistakes.right: डावा/उजवा — no sound overlap, must learn fresh
mistakes.why: Hindi बायाँ/दायाँ and Marathi डावा/उजवा share zero phonetics. This is pure vocabulary learning.
थांब is the root; the spoken command is थांबा (stop!) or थांबा एक मिनिट (wait a minute).
Hindi यहाँ/वहाँ vs Marathi इथे/तिथे — no sound overlap, must learn fresh.

mcq.question: Left in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: डावा = left; उजवा = right.

mcq.question: "Go straight" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: सरळ जा (straight go) — the standard direction command.

mcq.question: "Behind" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मागे (māge) = behind; समोर = in front.

fill.hint: Go straight, temple is on the right.

faq.question: How many direction words are on this page?
faq.answer: 16 — the core four (left/right/straight/stop), here/there, relative positions, and route words.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for "left"?
faq.answer: डावा (ḍāvā) — not बायाँ (that's Hindi).

title: Marathi Money & Shopping: Prices, Payment & Bargaining
description: Marathi money and shopping words - prices, quantities, payment methods, bargaining - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and market examples from Units 09 and Shopping category.
h1: Marathi Money & Shopping Words (पैसे आणि खरेदी)
intro: Marathi money and shopping vocabulary combining the Shopping category (12 words) and Numbers: prices (किंमत, महाग, स्वस्त), quantities (एक किलो, आधा किलो, पाव किलो), payment (रोख, ऑनलाइन, कार्ड, पावती), bargaining (थोडं कमी करा). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a market-ready example sentence.
The quantities and bargaining lines follow the exact same frame as Hindi: एक किलो भाजी द्या, थोडं कमी करा, कृपया. The Marathi you add is the vocabulary; the frame is identical.
tip: थोडं कमी करा, कृपया — the single most useful bargaining line. Say it with a smile; vendors expect it.

sections.heading: Quantities — identical to Hindi
paragraphs: एक किलो, आधा किलो, पाव किलो, दोन किलो — the Hindi speaker already knows these. The Marathi noun follows exactly as in Hindi: एक किलो भाजी, आधा किलो टोमॅटो.

sections.heading: Prices & payment
paragraphs: किंमत (price), महाग (expensive), स्वस्त (cheap), सूट (discount), रोख (cash), ऑनलाइन (online), कार्ड (card), पावती (receipt). The bargaining line: थोडं कमी करा, कृपया — reduce a little, please.

mistakes.why: Hindi कितना/कितनी/कितने collapses to Marathi किती — one word for all genders/numbers.
Same root, Marathi drops the nasal: महँगा → महाग.
नकद is formal; रोख is the everyday Marathi word vendors use.

mcq.question: How much is this in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: हे किती आहे? — the standard price question.

mcq.question: Reduce a little, please.
mcq.explanation: थोडं कमी करा, कृपया — exact Unit 09 line.

mcq.question: Cash in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: रोख (rokh) — everyday word; नकद is formal.

fill.hint: Generic vegetable ask — Unit 09 market sentence.

faq.question: How do you bargain in Marathi?
faq.answer: थोडं कमी करा, कृपया — reduce a little, please. The polite कृपया makes it standard etiquette.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for "expensive"?
faq.answer: महाग (mahāg) — same root as महँगा, nasal dropped.

title: Marathi Time Expressions: Clock, Duration, Frequency & Calendar
description: Marathi time vocabulary - clock words (तास, मिनिट, वाजले), durations (घंटा, तास, मिनिट), frequency (नेहमी, कधीच, रोज), calendar (आज, उद्या, काल, सप्ताह) - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and examples from Units 16 and 18.
intro: Marathi time vocabulary from Units 16 and 18 covering three layers: the clock (तास, मिनिट, वाजले), durations (तास, मिनिट, सकाळ, दुपार, संध्याकाळ, रात्र), and frequency (नेहमी, कधीच, कधीकधी, रोज, अजून). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

The grammar key: Marathi says the clock "has struck" - वाजले is the verb. साडे पाच वाजले = half past five (literally "five-and-a-half have struck"). Frequency adverbs (नेहमी, कधीच, रोज) sit immediately before the verb — Unit 18 drills this position.
tip: साडे + number + वाजले = half past. सवा + number + वाजले = quarter past. डेढ + number + वाजले = hour-and-a-half. The fraction + number + वाजले pattern covers all clock times.

sections.heading: The clock - वाजले frame
paragraphs: English "it is five o'clock" → Marathi पाच वाजले (five struck). English "half past five" → साडे पाच वाजले (five-and-a-half struck). The verb वाजले (struck) replaces both "is" and "o'clock". Quarter past: सवा पाच वाजले; hour-and-a-half: डेढ पाच वाजले.

sections.heading: Day parts & frequency
paragraphs: सकाळ (morning), दुपार (afternoon), संध्याकाळ (evening), रात्र (night). Frequency: नेहमी (always), रोज (daily), कधीकधी (sometimes), कधीच (never), अजून (still), आधीच (already). Position: adverb immediately before verb — मी रोज खेळतो, never मी खेळतो रोज.

mistakes.why: Marathi uses the verb वाजले (struck); बजे is Hindi.
Hindi कल does both; Marathi splits them. This is the #1 calendar false friend.

mistakes.right: Adverb before verb: मी रोज खेळतो (not मी खेळतो रोज)
mistakes.why: Unit 18 pattern — adverbs pre-verb, consistently.

mcq.question: Half past five in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: साडे पाच वाजले — साडे = half, वाजले = struck.

mcq.question: Tomorrow in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: उद्या = tomorrow. काल = yesterday — the trap.

mcq.question: Always in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: नेहमी (nehmi) = always.

fill.sentence: आता _____ वाजले. (It is now half past five.)

faq.question: How do you say "5 o'clock" in Marathi?
faq.answer: पाच वाजले — the verb वाजले (struck) replaces Hindi बजे.

faq.question: What is the biggest time trap for Hindi speakers?
faq.answer: काल means yesterday, not tomorrow. Tomorrow is उद्या. The verb वाजले (struck) replaces 'o'clock'.

title: Marathi Daily Expressions: Feelings, Adverbs & Ready Phrases
description: 46 Marathi phrases combining feelings, adverbs and daily expressions - मला आवडतं, खरंच, नक्की, होय नाही - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and curriculum examples.
intro: Forty-six Marathi phrases from the Phrases category (46) and Adverbs (30) covering feelings (मला आवडतं, मला भीती वाटते), adverbs (खरंच, नक्की, कदाचित, जवळजवळ), and ready-to-use daily expressions (काही हरकत नाही, बरोबर, चूक, पुन्हा सांगा, हळू बोला). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

These are the phrases you hear and say every day — not grammar exercises, but the actual sentences Marathi speakers use. The Phrases category (46) and Adverbs category (30) overlap here to give you the most useful daily expressions in one place.
tip: मला … आवडतं for likes, मला … वाटते for feelings, खरंच/नक्की for emphasis, कदाचित for uncertainty. These four frames cover 80% of daily expressive sentences.

sections.heading: The feeling frames
paragraphs: मला … आवडतं (I like …), मला … वाटते (I feel …), मला … आहे (I have … — for hunger, thirst, fever). The dative मला marks the experiencer; the feeling is the subject. Hindi मुझे … है maps directly.

sections.heading: Emphasis & uncertainty adverbs
paragraphs: खरंच (really/truly), नक्की (surely/definitely), कदाचित (maybe/perhaps), जवळजवळ (almost). These sit right before the verb or clause they modify: खरंच चांगले आहे (it's really good), कदाचित तो येईल (maybe he will come).

sections.heading: Ready daily phrases
paragraphs: काही हरकत नाही (it's alright / no problem), बरोबर (correct/okay), चूक (wrong/mistake), पुन्हा सांगा (say again), हळू बोला (speak slowly), मला समजलं नाही (I didn't understand). These are the social lubricant of Marathi conversation.

mistakes.wrong: Using खरंच for "really" in all contexts
mistakes.right: खरंच = truly/really; नक्की = surely/definitely; use based on certainty level
mistakes.why: खरंच = really/truly (emphasizing truth); नक्की = surely/definitely (expressing certainty). They are not fully interchangeable.
The च particle negates: कधी (when) → कधीच (never). कधीकधी = sometimes is the positive form.

mistakes.right: बरोबर as agreement comes mid-sentence or as response; as adjective it agrees: बरोबर उत्तर (correct answer)
mistakes.why: बरोबर functions as both interjection ("Right!") and adjective ("correct"). Position depends on function.

mcq.question: "Really?" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: खरंच? (kharanc?) = really?/truly? — the standard disbelief marker.

mcq.question: "No problem" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: काही हरकत नाही (kāhī harakat nāhī) — nothing wrong / it's alright.

mcq.question: "Maybe" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: कदाचित (kadācit) = maybe/perhaps.

translate.note: Emphasis adverb खरंच before the feeling frame.

faq.question: How many phrases are on this page?
faq.answer: 46 phrases combining feelings, adverbs and daily expressions — the most useful daily expressions in one place.

faq.question: What is the difference between खरंच and नक्की?
faq.answer: खरंच = really/truly (emphasizing truth); नक्की = surely/definitely (expressing certainty). Both are emphasis adverbs but with different nuance.

title: Marathi People & Occupations: Professions, Roles & Relations
description: 30+ Marathi occupation and people words - traditional professions, modern roles, family relations - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and surname connections from the Work and People categories.
intro: Thirty-plus Marathi occupation and people words from the Work (42) and People (10) categories: traditional professions (सुतार, लोहार, सोनार, शिंपी, न्हावी, धोबी), modern roles (अभियंता, वकील, डॉक्टर, शिक्षक), people relations (मित्र, मैत्रीण, शेजारी, पाहुणा, शेतकरी). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Many traditional professions are also surnames in Maharashtra — सुतार, लोहार, सोनार, शिंपी, न्हावी, धोबी, माळी, गवळी. Knowing the word means you recognize the surname too.
tip: Traditional professions = surnames: सुतार, लोहार, सोनार, शिंपी, न्हावी, धोबी, माळी, गवळी. The vocabulary and the family name are identical.

sections.heading: Traditional professions = surnames
paragraphs: सुतार (carpenter), लोहार (blacksmith), सोनार (goldsmith), शिंपी (tailor), न्हावी (barber), धोबी (washerman), माळी (gardener), गवळी (milkman) — identical words serve as job titles and family names across Maharashtra.

sections.heading: Modern roles & people relations
paragraphs: अभियंता (engineer), वकील (lawyer), डॉक्टर (doctor), शिक्षक (teacher), शेतकरी (farmer), दुकानदार (shopkeeper), पोलीस (police), फौजदार (soldier). People: मित्र (friend-male), मैत्रीण (friend-female), शेजारी (neighbour), पाहुणा (guest), शेतकरी (farmer).

mistakes.why: Hindi सिपाही = soldier; Marathi शिपाई is the office attendant. The soldier is सैनिक — direct false friend.

mistakes.right: मित्र = male friend; मैत्रीण = female friend
mistakes.why: Marathi marks gender explicitly in friend words. Hindi मित्र covers both; Marathi distinguishes.
आदमी is Hindi; माणूस (māṇūs) is the Marathi word for person/man.

mcq.question: Doctor in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: डॉक्टर (ḍŏkṭar) — the everyday word; वैद्य is traditional/Ayurvedic.

mcq.question: Female friend in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मैत्रीण (maitrīṇ) = female friend; मित्र = male friend.

mcq.question: Farmer in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: शेतकरी (śetkarī) = farmer; माळी = gardener.

faq.question: Are traditional professions also surnames in Marathi?
faq.answer: Yes — सुतार, लोहार, सोनार, शिंपी, न्हावी, धोबी, माळी, गवळी are both job titles and common surnames in Maharashtra.

faq.question: How do you say "person" in Marathi?
faq.answer: माणूस (māṇūs) — not आदमी (that's Hindi).

title: Marathi Abstract Concepts: World, Time, Values & Ideas
description: 36 Marathi abstract words - जग, देश, भाषा, धर्म, भविष्य, मूल्य, गुणवत्ता, धैर्य, अनुभव - with Hindi meanings, pronunciation and philosophical examples from the Abstract category.
intro: Thirty-six Marathi abstract words from the Abstract category: जग (world), देश (country), भाषा (language), धर्म (religion), भविष्य (future), भूतकाळ (past), परिणाम (result), मूल्य (value), गुणवत्ता (quality), धैर्य (patience/courage), अनुभव (experience), उद्देश (purpose), समस्या (problem), उपाय (solution), परिवर्तन (change). Every entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a philosophical example sentence.

Many abstract words are shared Sanskrit loans (देश, धर्म, भाषा, इतिहास, भविष्य, संस्कृती) - identical to Hindi. The shifts are in the functional words: जग (world), परिणाम (result), उपाय (solution), धैर्य (patience). These are the words that elevate conversation from transactional to meaningful.
tip: Learn in semantic clusters: time (भविष्य, भूतकाळ, वर्तमान), value (मूल्य, गुणवत्ता, परिणाम), agency (उद्देश, उपाय, धैर्य, अनुभव). The Sanskrit loans are free; the Marathi-specific ones are the leverage.

sections.heading: Time & existence
paragraphs: भविष्य (future), भूतकाळ (past), वर्तमान (present), जग (world), अस्तित्व (existence). The triad भविष्य/भूतकाळ/वर्तमान mirrors Hindi exactly — free vocabulary.

sections.heading: Values & agency
paragraphs: मूल्य (value), गुणवत्ता (quality), परिणाम (result), उद्देश (purpose), उपाय (solution), धैर्य (patience/courage), अनुभव (experience), परिवर्तन (change). These are the words of serious conversation — decisions, planning, reflection.

mistakes.why: दुनिया is the Hindi/Urdu word; जग (jag) is the standard Marathi word for world.
Hindi भूतकाल vs Marathi भूतकाळ — the ला/काळ shift is systematic.

mistakes.right: समस्या = problem; अडचण = difficulty/obstacle; त्रास = trouble/distress
mistakes.why: Marathi distinguishes problem types: समस्या (formal problem), अडचण (practical difficulty), त्रास (distress).

mcq.question: World in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: जग (jag) — the standard Marathi word for world.

mcq.question: Future in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: भविष्य (bhaviṣya) — identical to Hindi, free vocabulary.

mcq.question: Patience/courage in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: धैर्य (dhairya) = patience/courage — covers both nuances.

faq.question: How many abstract words are on this page?
faq.answer: 36 — covering time, existence, values, agency and social concepts, each with Hindi meaning and philosophical example.

faq.question: Are abstract words similar to Hindi?
faq.answer: Most are shared Sanskrit loans (देश, धर्म, भाषा, इतिहास, भविष्य, संस्कृती) — identical. The Marathi-specific ones (जग, परिणाम, उपाय, धैर्य) are the high-leverage ones to learn.
